protections_tested: missing and unlisted extra files and directories
modified dependency Git blob or SHA-256
mismatched source archive members, bytes, ordering or metadata
missing arbitrary-wrapper manifest or checksum entries
changed or deleted verification wrappers and entry points
deletion with all manifests/checksums/source archive deliberately resealed
public builder preflight before archive generation
verified external archive output only to a new outside file
maintenance flag required and mandatory-code deletion refused
limits: Integrity is consistency relative to a trusted manifest; no digital signature or mathematical proof certification is implied.
